declarations.type:
∀ (left right : ASPProof.ServerResidentIncrementalIndex.IndexDelta),
  left.workspace = right.workspace →
    left.baseGeneration = right.baseGeneration →
      left.workspaceSnapshot = right.workspaceSnapshot →
        left.provider ≠ right.provider → ASPProof.ServerResidentIncrementalIndex.CanCoalesce left right
declarations.name: ASPProof.ServerResidentIncrementalIndex.distinct_provider_deltas_can_coalesce

declarations.type:
∀ (left right : ASPProof.ServerResidentIncrementalIndex.IndexDelta),
  left.provider = right.provider →
    left.snapshotRevision ≠ right.snapshotRevision → ¬ASPProof.ServerResidentIncrementalIndex.CanCoalesce left right
declarations.name: ASPProof.ServerResidentIncrementalIndex.same_provider_different_snapshot_cannot_coalesce

declarations.type:
∀ (state : ASPProof.ServerResidentIncrementalIndex.IndexState)
  (required : ASPProof.ServerResidentIncrementalIndex.ProviderId → Bool)
  (batch : ASPProof.ServerResidentIncrementalIndex.StagedBatch)
  (provider : ASPProof.ServerResidentIncrementalIndex.ProviderId),
  required provider = true →
    batch.coveredProviders provider = false → ¬ASPProof.ServerResidentIncrementalIndex.CanPublish state required batch
declarations.name: ASPProof.ServerResidentIncrementalIndex.incomplete_batch_cannot_publish

declarations.type:
∀ (state : ASPProof.ServerResidentIncrementalIndex.IndexState)
  (receipt : ASPProof.ServerResidentIncrementalIndex.CacheReceipt),
  receipt.modelPrefixHit = true →
    receipt.searchGeneration ≠ state.activeGeneration →
      ASPProof.ServerResidentIncrementalIndex.ModelPrefixHit receipt ∧
        ¬ASPProof.ServerResidentIncrementalIndex.SearchCacheValid state receipt
declarations.name: ASPProof.ServerResidentIncrementalIndex.model_prefix_hit_does_not_validate_search_cache

declarations.type:
∀ (state : ASPProof.ServerResidentIncrementalIndex.IndexState)
  (receipt : ASPProof.ServerResidentIncrementalIndex.CacheReceipt),
  receipt.searchGeneration = state.activeGeneration →
    receipt.modelPrefixHit = false →
      ASPProof.ServerResidentIncrementalIndex.SearchCacheValid state receipt ∧
        ¬ASPProof.ServerResidentIncrementalIndex.ModelPrefixHit receipt
declarations.name: ASPProof.ServerResidentIncrementalIndex.valid_search_cache_does_not_imply_model_prefix_hit
